content: Item files are never moved or deleted by attach or detach. Those operations change only the entries and selection recorded in item.json.
Project checks run from the project root: `npx tsc --noEmit` and `node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/*.test.ts`.

`attach --run` on a texture-uv run root in `src/item.ts` (`buildAttachEntriesForTextureUvRun`, `resolveTakeFolderPaths`) adds one texture entry per take-N folder that has color.png, and one preview entry per take-N folder that has preview.png, each named by its take. A root with no usable files is rejected as an error, and no root-level entry is created. In `server.ts`, `discoverTextureTakeFolders` probes take-1 through take-8 via the host.

In `src/item.ts`, `selectTextureTake` also selects the preview entry of the same take, with the same selectedBy. `stepIsDone` and `previewSatisfiedForSelectedTexture` treat the preview step as done when the selected texture take has a preview, so nextStep moves past preview once texture and export are selected.

`detachEntry` in `src/item.ts` removes one entry from an item step and clears the step's selection if that entry was selected. Files stay on disk. It is exposed as the CLI command `model item detach --item <id> --step <step> --entry <id>` and as the `detach` action of `image_studio_item` in `server.ts`.

`skills/image-studio/references/model-textures.md` lists detach in the item command table. Its troubleshooting section describes repairing a wrong run-root attach by detaching the dead entry and then selecting the correct take.

`tests/item-fixes.test.ts` covers these cases: a run root with take-1 and take-2 adds two named texture entries and no root entry; a folder without color.png errors; selecting a texture take selects its preview; nextStep is done after texture and export; detach removes an entry and clears its selection. `tests/item-cli.test.ts` already existed and gained `detach` CLI parsing cases.
`package.json` version is 0.9.3 after the item-fixes change.
